interest: Indexes 1930-36 docket sheets on Japan's naval maneuvers, including doctrine for attrition attacks on the US fleet via the Mandates.
overview: Docket sheets (1930-36) on Japanese naval maneuvers: 1930 air-corps exercises in the Carolines/Marshalls with attrition doctrine against the US fleet, 1933 Army-Navy propaganda maneuvers, and 1935-36 fleet maneuvers reported from Paris and Batavia.

people.name: Kijūrō Shidehara
people.role: Minister for Foreign Affairs of Japan

subfiles.about: A Department of State List of Papers docket sheet indexing communications on Japanese naval maneuvers from 1930 to 1933.
subfiles.summary: Lists 1930 Navy maneuvers in the Carolines/Marshalls with attrition doctrine against the US fleet, and 1933 Army-Navy propaganda maneuvers.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Naval maneuvers--Japan (Entries 9 and 11)

subfiles.about: A Department of State continuation List of Papers docket sheet indexing documents and cross-references on Japanese naval maneuvers from 1935 to 1936.
subfiles.summary: Lists a Navy memo on Japanese naval maneuvers reported from Paris, and a 1936 Batavia despatch on Japanese fleet maneuvers.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Naval Maneuvers - Japan (Entries 12 and 13)
